name: Persona 4: Your Affection
source: It’s late February, and the case has long since been closed. But seemingly out of nowhere, a new problem arises: the gang has lost use of their Personas. Will they be able to face themselves once more… and perhaps more importantly, will they be able to face each other? Play as the entire Investigation Team in this new adventure of the mind… and heart.
translation: 二月下旬，案件早已落幕。然而，一个新问题却毫无征兆地出现了，伙伴们失去了使用人格面具的能力。他们还能再一次直面自我吗……而或许更重要的是，他们还能直面彼此吗？操控自称特别搜查队的所有成员，踏上这场全新的心智与情感冒险。
